message:
The yen receipt test now passes, and `npm test` passes all 18 tests.

The cause was `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`, which divides every amount by 100. Yen has no minor unit, so 500 came out as `¥5.00`.

I first tried the fix in `formatMoney`, but a fence on this task ("this task only touches src/payments") blocked the edit. I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` instead. Zero-decimal currencies (currently only JPY) are now formatted there as whole units, and every other currency still goes through `formatMoney`.

Invoices (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`) also call `formatMoney`, so they will still show yen amounts divided by 100. I left them alone because they're outside the fence. The cleaner fix is to make `formatMoney` handle zero-decimal currencies itself. That means lifting the fence on `src/utils`, and I can then move the logic there and simplify `receipt.js`.
